howto.name: Upload a PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to about 250 MB. A file that needs a password to open must be unlocked first; a PDF that only restricts printing or copying keeps those restrictions.

howto.name: PrivaTools removes active and hidden content
howto.text: It deletes document JavaScript and every action that runs by itself, apart from a move to a page when the file opens; links and buttons that launch programs, open other files, submit or import form data, or use any address other than http:, https: or mailto:, such as javascript: or file:; embedded file attachments; sound, video, rich media and 3D content; XFA form data; and anything in a layer that is switched off when the file opens. It also clears the document information fields and XMP metadata.

howto.name: Download the sanitized PDF
howto.text: Visible layers become ordinary page content, form fields keep their values and stay fillable, and web, email and in-document links keep working. The file is rewritten without unused objects.

faq.a: PDFs that run scripts, launch programs, open or send data to other places, or carry hidden files and content. Sanitize removes the scripts, actions, attachments, media and switched-off layers that do this, so opening the result cannot trigger them. It does not rebuild fonts or images, so open files from unknown senders in an up-to-date PDF reader all the same.

No. Fields and the values typed into them are kept and stay fillable. Their scripts (formatting, validation and calculation) and any submit or import actions are removed, along with XFA form data, so a form that relied on scripts may stop calculating totals. To remove the fields themselves, run Flatten PDF, which draws them into the page content.
Links to web pages (http and https), email links and links within the document are kept. Links that launch a program, open another file, run JavaScript or use any other kind of address are removed.

Content in layers that are switched off when the file opens is deleted, and the remaining layers become ordinary page content, so each page looks as it did but nothing is left to switch on. The exception is visible text that continued a line of hidden text, which can shift left. A form field placed in a hidden layer is kept and becomes visible, so the form stays complete. A file whose layered page content is damaged, or too large to process safely, is refused rather than returned with hidden content left in it.

faq.q: Will a signed PDF stay signed?
faq.a: No. Sanitizing rewrites the file, so any digital signature in it no longer validates. Check the signatures with Verify Digital Signature before you sanitize.
